name: nepali-date-skills
description: Standard agent skills for Bikram Sambat calendar, date conversions, and fiscal accounting.

skills.name: Convert BS Date to AD Date
skills.description: Converts a Bikram Sambat (Nepali) date string (YYYY-MM-DD) into Gregorian (AD) equivalent.

bsDate.description: Nepali date in YYYY-MM-DD format (1976-01-01 to 2100-12-31)

skills.name: Convert AD Date to BS Date
skills.description: Converts a Gregorian (English/AD) date string into Bikram Sambat (BS) equivalent.

skills.name: Get Monthly Nepali Calendar Grid
skills.description: Returns 42-day calendar matrix for any Bikram Sambat year and month with Saturday and Sunday detection.

skills.name: Nepali Government Fiscal Year Calculator
skills.description: Calculates Nepali government fiscal year and current quarter (Q1 Shrawan-Ashoj, Q2 Kartik-Poush, Q3 Magh-Chaitra, Q4 Baisakh-Ashadh).
